event_detail: Drawer in front: the gripper reaches the drawer handle at 8.0 s (open fingers, handle filling the wrist view) but does not pull it; it then wanders down in front of the cabinet face and back up to the handle area by 12.8 s, with the drawer still closed.
evidence: In both shoulder views the drawer fronts below the counter stay flush/closed in all 4 moments; wrist camera shows the handle at 8.0 s, then cabinet panel and floor at 9.6 and 11.2 s, then the countertop edge and a handle at 12.8 s; no straw is held and no drawer interior is ever visible. Cannot rule out that the robot is just re-approaching the handle.
